Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the directors’ birth dates despite WebSurfer providing correct data. Oscar Barney Finn’s correct birth date (1938-10-28) was replaced with 1986-06-19, and Jason Michael Brescia’s correct birth date (1986-06-19) was incorrectly changed to 1943-06-09. This swap/fabrication led to the wrong conclusion that The Newest Pledge’s director was born earlier, whereas the correct earlier-born director is Oscar Barney Finn, making Más Allá De La Aventura the correct answer.
